serve -barrier 3 -timeout 5s body.json
expand src_var.cel src.cel

mito -use http src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- body.json --
{"ok":true}
-- src_var.cel --
[1, 2, 3].map(x, string(get("${URL}").Body))
-- want.txt --
[
	"barrier timeout: only 1 of 3 requests arrived",
	"barrier timeout: only 2 of 3 requests arrived",
	"{\"ok\":true}\n"
]
